description: This file defines classes and templates related to WebSocket protocol handling within a web framework. It includes the Protocol class for WebSocket frame processing, allocators for WebRequest and WebResponse objects, and a templated WebSocketLinkType class that manages WebSocket connections, including upgrade procedures, message serialization/deserialization, and connection state management.

classes.name: Protocol
classes.description: Handles WebSocket frame encoding, decoding, and control frame management, including masking and key generation.

classes.name: RequestAllocator
classes.description: A singleton pool allocator for Web::Request objects.

classes.name: ResponseAllocator
classes.description: A singleton pool allocator for Web::Response objects.

classes.name: WebSocketLinkType
classes.description: A templated class managing WebSocket connection lifecycle, including upgrade, message handling, and state transitions.

methods.name: ResponseKey
methods.description: Generates a WebSocket response key based on a request key.

methods.name: Encoder
methods.description: Encodes a data frame for WebSocket transmission.

methods.name: Decoder
methods.description: Decodes a received WebSocket data frame.
